mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to start an AI-powered online business?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The cost depends on the AI platform, connected services, domains, email tools, payment systems, advertising, and any educational or mastermind resources you choose. Run My AI Biz describes a free newsletter starting option and a $9-per-month paid newsletter subscription, while the external mastermind is a separate offering with its own terms and price.

Context: A low subscription price does not equal a complete business budget. You may also need hosting, design, checkout, delivery, automation, or data-storage services, and usage-based AI charges can change with volume.

Key factors:
- Which tools are essential for the first workflow.
- Whether a free plan includes needed integrations.
- Recurring fees, usage limits, and cancellation terms.
- The value of saved time compared with setup and review effort.

Practical guidance: Make a simple monthly cost sheet before subscribing. Start with one workflow and avoid paying for multiple tools until each has a defined job.

Run My AI Biz provides education and tool comparisons, not a guarantee that a particular stack will be profitable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary beyond the AI subscription. Budget for tools such as hosting, email, checkout, delivery, automation, and possible usage fees. Run My AI Biz lists a free newsletter option and a $9-per-month paid newsletter subscription; separate programs have separate pricing.
